City Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC
(formerly CQS Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC)
The Board of the Company announces that, with effect from 15 September 2026, the name of the Company has changed to City Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC.

The Company’s new name recognises the change of alternative investment fund manager (“AIFM”) and removes any legacy name overhang from the previous AIFM. There will be no change to the Company's strategy or risk profile; the Company will continue to pursue its established investment approach with a primary focus on long-term capital growth and the payment of an enhanced dividend yield of 8% of net asset value per annum, funded from capital reserves as required.

The Company's London Stock Exchange TIDM (Tradable Instrument Display Mnemonic) remains CYN. The Company's ISIN, SEDOL and LEI also remain unchanged. Companies House confirms that the Company’s new name has been registered and, following receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation on Change of Name, the Company will liaise with the FCA and the LSE to affect the name change on the Official List and for trading purposes as soon as practicable.

Shareholders should note that their shareholdings will be unaffected by the change of name. Existing share certificates should be retained as they will remain valid for all purposes and no replacement share certificates will be issued in connection with the change of name.
Shareholders are reminded that, following the change in AIFM and Investment Manager with effect from 14 September 2026, the Company’s new website is www.citynats.com.
City Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC
About City Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC
City Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC

is a closed-end investment trust which aims to provide shareholders with capital growth and income predominantly from a portfolio of mining and resource equities and of mining, resource and industrial fixed interest securities.

The trust provides exposure to value focused, under‑researched global energy and resources equities. The established investment approach is focused on long-term capital growth and the payment of an enhanced dividend yield of 8% of net asset value per annum, funded from capital reserves as required.

Tufton Investment Management Ltd is a specialist investment manager focused primarily on the maritime, raw materials, and energy-related sectors. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in London with offices in Geneva, Cyprus, and the Isle of Man, the firm manages public and private funds for institutional investors, including major UK pension funds.

Tufton's principal investment mandates are executed by Tufton Investment Management Ltd which manages investments for public and private funds and other clients, including UK-listed flagship fund Tufton Assets Limited

Over the past two decades, Tufton has managed over $3 billion for institutional investors, including UK pension funds, and has launched publicly listed investment vehicles on the London Stock Exchange and Oslo Euronext Growth. Tufton’s assets under management, including committed pipeline capital, is over $1.5 billion, across public and private funds and mandates. Tufton Investment Management Ltd is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
